people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

translations.web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
translations.bsb: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark.
translations.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
translations.asv: And Barnabas was minded to take with them John also, who was called Mark.
